chapter: Career, brass bands and choice of instrument
title: Leaders he has worked with
summary: He lists Sidney Desvigne, Robichaux, Celestine, Kid Howard, Barbarin and others, and says he worked nearly every Bourbon Street house.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Is there anything else about your life, or the different bands you've played with, or the men you've heard or worked with? Well I'll tell you. You're going to be off, we have three or four more minutes on here, we don't have to come up.

Well I got, I got to tell you. Okay. I done worked, I done worked with Sidney Dazman, Joe Rubenshill, Celestine, quite a few other fellows, Kid Howard, John Lewis, Paul Barberman, and the kids were gigging with, I didn't gig with most everybody in the world. Everybody that I knew of, and still gigging with a lot of the younger fellows. And practically I didn't work every house on Bourbon Street.
